svg.title: Zip-tie station 2 position
svg.desc: Two top views of one plate of the two-sided puller, before left and after right, the plug end at the top. Left: the defaults with plug length set to 40 and zip-tie station placement set to Manual, a 20 mm wide plug in teal. Right: zip-tie station 2 position at 36 mm. Marked in red: 1, the zip stations and the strap slot: the three small holes along each arm; the long slot in each arm.
